entry.title: Podcast: Requirements Analysis for Architects: A Conversation with Sonya Natanzon (Source: feed.infoq.com)
entry.summary: Michael Stiefel spoke to Sonya Natanzon, about the intersection of technical and social aspects of software architecture. Understanding the business and how a company operates is more important than the specific technologies used. Effective requirements analysis requires focusing on problems to be solved that describe good and bad outcomes, rather than statements of need or solution statements. By Sonya Natanzon
